name: Attribute value inside genetic min-max
state: per-attribute current value, min, max (per limb open)
formulation: current moves toward max with use, toward min with disuse, inside [min,max_today]; scale 1-20, 10 = ordinary sailor (proposed)
approximations: scale 1-20 and rates open for Rex
notes: Gameplay scale (1-20) is pirate design authority; the underlying biology (genetic range, use/disuse) is universal. Same idea as realism/src/muscular.ts createMuscularState/adaptMuscleDay (per-muscle min/max, logistic toward max, disuse -0.3/day after 14 idle days). Two parallel min-max systems: STATS attribute vs MUSCULAR group.

name: Attribute list and scope (per limb / head / whole body)
formulation: lookup table: Strength, Dexterity, Reflexes per limb; Endurance, Agility, Constitution, Nerve, Poise, Efficiency whole body; senses/mind in head
notes: Pirate gameplay catalogue. Classification: UNIVERSAL biology = Strength, Endurance, Agility, Dexterity, Reflexes, Constitution, Eyesight, Hearing, Taste and smell (each has physiological drivers in body docs). Cognition (domain C) = Wits, Memory, Perception, Pattern Recognition, Intuition, Spatial Reasoning, Nerve. PIRATE GAMEPLAY = Poise, Efficiency (action-point spend) and the mapping of eight function names onto attributes.

name: Eight cognitive functions as combat attributes
formulation: Eyesight Si, Perception Se, PatternRec Ne, Hearing Fe, Intuition Ni, SpatialReasoning Ti, Poise Fi, Efficiency Te; Endurance = pool, Efficiency = spend per action
notes: MBTI-function mapping; belongs to the future Cognition domain C plugin layer, never universal. PLATFORM.md says the eight-function model must be configurable, never hardcoded.

name: Age lowers attribute maximum, injuries cut it
formulation: max_today = genetic_max x ageCurve(attr,age) x injuryCap(attr) (formula restated in PHYSIOLOGY §8)
notes: Duplicate statement of PHYSIOLOGY.md §8 (same rule). Single owner should be PHYSIOLOGY ageing; STATS keeps only the gameplay scale.

name: Skill level 0-100, never falls
formulation: gain on practice; level never decreases (Rex)
notes: Progression: pirate gameplay (domain C learning if ever generalised). A real-world sim would let skill decay; Rex's rule says never.

name: Skill rust debuff after disuse
formulation: debuff about 10 pts after 1 yr, 20 after 2 yrs; clears after 1-2 uses
notes: Pirate gameplay; a forgetting curve (domain C memory/learning).

name: Talent multiplier per skill
formulation: fixed multiplier 0.5-2.0 on learning
notes: Pirate gameplay.

name: Claimed vs real skill
formulation: dialogue reads claim, work reads truth; lies can be exposed
notes: Pirate gameplay/narrative.

name: Skill to attribute/personality dependency table
formulation: lookup: 25 skills x primary (weight 2), secondary, personality slider, duty
notes: Pure gameplay table: a dependency graph between attributes and skills, no calculation.

name: Skill learning gain (earlier draft)
formulation: gain = base x attrFactor x persFactor x talent x ageFactor; attrFactor = prod (value/10)^w (primary 2, secondary 1, normalised to sum 1); persFactor up to +-25%
sources: Rex: reference only; method is skill by skill
notes: Marked reference only by Rex (Fishing first, minigames/FISHING.md).

name: Performance = skill x attribute factor x state
formulation: performance = skill x attribute_factor(today) x state
notes: Same formula restated in BODY.md §2 and PSYCHOLOGY.md §3. BODY.md is the declared owner of 'state'.

formulation: slow drift toward the pole the character is treated as; sliders feed leaving, claims, madness
notes: Domain C. Two personality models coexist (16-type fixed + 13 sliders), both overlapping with the planned eight-function model for domain C.

notes: Game-grid unit: pirate-specific.

name: Endurance pool ceiling and now
formulation: ceiling = Endurance_attr x (aerobic_today/40); now = ceiling x (1-0.5 fatigueDay) x alertness x hydr x glycogen x fever x blood x heat; overnight refill to ceiling x sleep x hydr x glycogen
approximations: BODY §3 formula has 7 factors; PHYSIOLOGY §6 lists 4 factors in the block and omits heatFactor; aerobic_today/40 assumes a VO2max-index scale
notes: DOC INCONSISTENCY: BODY.md §2/§3 include heatFactor; the PHYSIOLOGY.md §6 formula block stops at bloodFactor. UNIT CONFLICT: aerobic_today/40 needs an index (~mL/kg/min); realism/src/circulation.ts sets out.aerobic_today = DO2 at maximal cardiac output in mL O2/min. Only glycogenFactor is built (nutrition.ts). The pool is a game construct (pirate-specific); its ceiling driver (VO2max) is universal.

name: State multiplier (mood x madness x drink)
formulation: each of mood, madness, drink mapped to 0.5-1.0 and multiplied; fatigue, sickness, injury excluded (already in attribute-today)
notes: Domain C + game meters. THREE statements of one formula: STATS.md §4 lists six state items (mood, madness, drink, fatigue, sickness, injury); BODY.md halves to three; PSYCHOLOGY.md §3 repeats the six-item list while saying it does not compute state.

notes: The (1-0.5 fatigueDay) term repeats the pool formula's constant.

notes: Magic constants (2-alertness), (1+fatigueDay) with no source.

approximations: MET values are nearest-activity, not measured on sailors
tests: physiology.test.ts 'costs an activity at its MET times the resting rate'; 'conserves energy'; 'makes the day's PAL...'
notes: ALSO IN realism/src/physiology.ts (metOf, physiologyProcess). PAL bands: library physiology.pal.

notes: ALSO IN realism/src/atmosphere.ts (breathingProcess; header lines 14-15 hold the same constants). Realism owns it; doc is a view. Library table is physiology.ventilation but the code lives in atmosphere.ts.

name: Aerobic capacity by Banister fitness-fatigue
formulation: fitness = sum load e^(-(t-i)/42); fatigue = sum load e^(-(t-i)/7); aerobic_today = ceiling x clamp(0.6 + k1 fit - k2 fat, 0.6, 1.0)
tests: none for physiology; muscular variant: muscular.test.ts 'uses the Banister 42/7 day impulse response'
notes: CONFLICT x3: (1) prose says k1 = 0.4/42, k2 = 0.4/7; table physiology.banister says k1 = 1, k2 = 1.3 (realism muscularBanisterDay uses the table). (2) PHYSIOLOGY §2 says aerobic_today = oxygen delivery at max cardiac output (CIRCULATION) but gives a Banister index formula; realism circulation.ts out.aerobic_today = DO2(maxCO) in mL/min, and muscular.ts muscularBanisterDay's comment says its result is NOT the circulation aerobic_today. (3) Whole-body Banister is not in physiology.ts; only the muscular variant is built. Needs one owner.

notes: ALSO IN realism/src/physiology.ts sleepDebtRow, overnight, out.alertness. Matches.
